cohort: Singleton pregnant women undergoing a routine mid-trimester ultrasound scan for fetal abnormalities at 20-24 weeks of gestation.
finding: The mid-trimester ultrasound scan demonstrated good accuracy (94.3%) and specificity (96.3%) but moderate sensitivity (61.1%) in detecting congenital malformations, suggesting it should not be the sole screening test.
cross-section timing: 20-24 weeks of gestation (for the ultrasound scan)
